limits: Approval covers this intentional regression-fixture transition only. Full frozen-source native tests, regenerated production/fixture comparison, integrated service/motion checks and exports remain release requirements.
No physical print fit, screw torque, key alignment accuracy, strength, servo radial load, PA12 creep/fatigue, bonded flexibility, adhesion, actual wires or flight performance is qualified.

Simplification does not establish improved whole-rail flexibility. Total free span decreases from78 to64 mm; continuous base width is now5 mm rather than a6-to4.5 mm waist. Test loaded curvature and adhesive/envelope interaction.

Nominal0.2 mm key face/depth allowance and slot/bore clearances enable assembly, not operating play or automatic alignment. Finish or reprint interfering/rocking joints, seat them fully and qualify clamp retention without forcing the mesh.

Shared retention removes four separate fastener objects but couples rail release and servo-bridge release. Support both assemblies, disconnect leads and perform servo replacement on an unpowered bench after lifting the propulsion module off the rail.
The ordinary50 mm rail coupon validates the standard rail foot only; it does not qualify full rail curvature, adhesive behaviour or the new shared key joint.
